references.context: Field theory: arbitrary field extension K of a subfield k
references.reason: An unrestricted extension does not presume algebraicity; save for later global grouping.

references.phrase: element of K algebraic over k
references.matching_note: This is precisely the existing concept of an element satisfying a polynomial over the base field.
The equivalent statement uses the separately indexed relative algebraic closure inside an extension.

references.disposition: This is the property being DEFINED and is not the unrelated assertion that k is an algebraically closed field in its own right.

review_rationale: Read the relatively algebraically closed extension formulation as distinct from an algebraically closed field, linked algebraic elements and relative closure while deferring general field-extension terminology.
